FINDING (high, correctness): F009 baseline is still not captured before all plan-loading reads at dispatch start. Evidence: `dispatch_volley` calls `sufficiency_gate.enforce_sufficiency_gate(plan_dir)` and `completion_gate.enforce_completion_gate(plan_dir)` before `compute_fingerprint` / `record_baseline` at `supervisor.py:1398-1417`; those gates read `plan.md` and, when gated, feature/objective inputs. Recommendation: move F009 fingerprint capture to the top of `dispatch_volley`, before these backstops, then keep the post-load drift check.

FINDING (medium, test_coverage): Required volley-path concurrent-edit coverage is incomplete. Evidence: new supervisor tests cover `features.json` acceptance, `audit/gate-state.json`, fail-closed raise, missing baseline, and finalize, while loop caps, human gates, roles, allowed paths, objective contract, and additive `decisions.jsonl` are only covered by pure classifier/reconcile tests, not volley-path concurrent edit tests. Recommendation: add parameterized volley tests proving each required mutation pauses or reconciles before the next paid call.
